breve: A class to interact with the editor debugger.
descricao:
This class cannot be directly instantiated and must be retrieved via an EditorDebuggerPlugin.
You can add tabs to the session UI via 'add_session_tab', send messages via 'send_message', and toggle EngineProfilers via 'toggle_profiler'.

metodos.desc: Adds the given 'control' to the debug session UI in the debugger bottom panel. The 'control''s node name will be used as the tab title.
Returns true if the debug session is currently attached to a remote instance.
Returns true if the attached remote instance is currently in the debug loop.
Returns true if the attached remote instance can be debugged.
Removes the given 'control' from the debug session UI in the debugger bottom panel.
Sends the given 'message' to the attached remote instance, optionally passing additionally 'data'. See EngineDebugger for how to retrieve those messages.

metodos.assinatura: set_breakpoint(path: String, line: int, enabled: bool) -> void
metodos.desc: Enables or disables a specific breakpoint based on 'enabled', updating the Editor Breakpoint Panel accordingly.

metodos.assinatura: toggle_profiler(profiler: String, enable: bool, data: Array = []) -> void
metodos.desc: Toggle the given 'profiler' on the attached remote instance, optionally passing additionally 'data'. See EngineProfiler for more details.

sinais.desc: Emitted when the attached remote instance enters a break state. If 'can_debug' is true, the remote instance will enter the debug loop.
Emitted when the attached remote instance exits a break state.
Emitted when a remote instance is attached to this session (i.e. the session becomes active).
Emitted when a remote instance is detached from this session (i.e. the session becomes inactive).
